title: Trigger.dev
description: Open-source background jobs framework for TypeScript. Write long-running tasks, resilient queues, and AI agent workflows with zero serverless timeouts.
features: No serverless execution timeouts: run background tasks lasting seconds, hours, or days
Real-time visual dashboard with detailed step-level execution telemetry and logs
Automatic retries with exponential backoff and idempotency key protection
First-class AI orchestration support (streaming LLM calls, chunk processing, long pipelines)
Self-hostable via Docker or managed cloud platform with zero DevOps
pros: Solves the dreaded 10s-60s serverless timeout ceiling on Vercel/AWS Lambda
Code-first workflows written in standard TypeScript functions
cons: Cloud plan pricing charges per machine execution second after free credits
Requires understanding distributed queue semantics for concurrent task tuning
targetAudience: Full-stack engineers building AI scraping pipelines, video rendering, and asynchronous workflows.
